caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object placed in the center of a light beige, plain background. The object is rusty brown in color with subtle shading to indicate texture and depth. It has a flat, elongated form with an oval loop on one end featuring a pointed tip and a heart-like cutout inside it. The other end splits into two prongs extending outward. The artist’s signature, “Marion N. Hanson,” appears in brown ink in the lower right corner of the drawing. The composition is minimal, with the object centrally positioned and substantial empty space surrounding it.
title: Bootjack
